what: The prose says the extending document is context for the extended one (e->d), while the formula says the extended document is context for the extender (d->e). 'Transitive through extension' does not say that what is context for the extended document is also context for the extender.
collapse: put 'is context for it' on the wrong document and named the second rule as 'transitive'
fix: When a document extends another, the other is context for it, and so is every document that is context for the other.

what: The formula needs the checker to report that the scenario cannot happen (Raised). The prose says the scenario is impossible (Impossible), which is a different set.
collapse: swapped 'checker reports that it cannot happen' for the adjective 'impossible'
fix: For each scenario that checker reports cannot happen, checker names in its report of the scenario each unit whose removal lets it happen.

what: The formula needs the analyzer to be asked about the contradicting unit together with the other unit (u->v). 'every unit that the analyzer is asked about together with it' reads as asked about the other unit together with it (v->u), and Together is not symmetric.
collapse: turned the second argument into the head of a relative clause, which flips the order
fix: When a unit is held with units that cannot all hold and the analyzer is asked about it together with a unit, checker names that unit in its report of a contradiction.

what: 'repeats another' requires the repeated unit to differ from the repeating one. The formula also covers a unit that repeats itself.
collapse: said 'another' for an unrestricted second unit
fix: When a unit repeats a unit, checker reports a rotting for the repeating unit.

what: Run sits in the outermost quantifier, so the formula requires the unreadable report only when at least one run exists. The prose requires the report even when there are no runs.
collapse: pulled 'every run' out of the outer quantifier into the consequent
fix: For every run: when a document starts with a refused frontmatter, checker reports that the document has a frontmatter it cannot read, and the run exits with code 2.

what: The formula's condition is that the rule's two sides are not each one clause (OneLineRule). 'not on one line' names a different predicate: the verbalizer saying the rule on one line (OneLine).
collapse: named the input property by its usual output
fix: Verbalizer says a rule whose two sides are not each one clause with "then" at the start of the second side, on a line of its own.

what: Run sits in the outermost quantifier, so the formula requires the unreadable report only when at least one run exists. The prose requires the report even when there are no runs.
collapse: pulled 'every run' out of the outer quantifier into the consequent
fix: For every run: when a document starts with a refused frontmatter, checker reports that the document has a frontmatter it cannot read, and the run exits with code 2.

what: In the formula a reading in the unit says the word (Voice). 'used in one unit' reads as a claim, definition or fact using it (Rely). 'declared in another' also leaves it open whether the first unit itself does not declare the word.
collapse: used the verb 'used' for 'a reading says' and folded 'not declared here, declared elsewhere' into 'declared in another'
fix: When a reading in a unit says a word that the unit does not declare but some unit declares, the word is apart.

what: 'another document that is context for it' requires the context document to differ from the checked one. The formula allows them to be the same document.
collapse: said 'another document' for an unrestricted second document
fix: When the project lists a document among those it checks, and a document that is context for it holds a unit whose formula has no keyword, the analyzer is asked to hold that unit's formula.

what: Run sits in the outermost quantifier, so the formula requires the lacks-plugin report only when at least one run exists. The prose requires the report even when there are no runs.
collapse: pulled 'every run' out of the outer quantifier into the consequent
fix: For every run: when a frontmatter lists a missing plugin, checker reports that the project lacks that plugin, and the run exits with code 2.

what: Run sits in the outermost quantifier, so the formula requires the lacks-plugin report only when at least one run exists. The prose requires the report even when there are no runs.
collapse: pulled 'every run' out of the outer quantifier into the consequent
fix: For every run: when a frontmatter lists a missing plugin, checker reports that the project lacks it, and the run exits with code 2.

what: The formula fixes the cleanups at the moment the parent is disposed: those registered, not yet run and on the parent at that moment. The prose says 'before then no cleanup that code has registered on the parent and that has not run runs', which tests those conditions at every moment before the child is disposed, so it also covers cleanups registered later.
collapse: put the cleanup's conditions inside 'before then' instead of anchoring them at the disposal moment
fix: …pulse disposes that owner now or later, and no cleanup that, at this moment, code has registered, that is on the parent and that has not run, runs before then;

what: The prose drops the condition that the unit has a statement (Stated). It only presupposes the statement through the possessive "A unit's statement".
collapse: turned a condition into a possessive presupposition
fix: When a unit has a statement, holds a formula that can be said in words, and its statement does not sit between the markers of a generated region, its statement is handwritten.

what: 'shares a word with another' requires the two units to differ. The formula also covers a unit that shares a word with itself.
collapse: said 'another' for an unrestricted second unit
fix: When a unit shares a word with a unit, the analyzer is asked about the first together with the second.

what: 'context for another document' requires the two documents to differ. The formula allows a document to be context for itself.
collapse: said 'another document' for an unrestricted second document
fix: If a document that is context for a document holds a unit with a block that names a word outside its declaration, checker does not report the formula of any unit of the latter document as lone on that word.

what: 'another' requires the two units to differ, and 'asked about them together' loses the order of Together, which is not symmetric. The formula allows the same unit and fixes the order unit_1 before unit_2.
collapse: said 'another' and merged the ordered pair into 'them'
fix: When a unit shares a word with a unit, the analyzer is asked about the first together with the second.

what: 'together with another' requires the two units to differ. The formula also covers a unit asked about together with itself.
collapse: said 'another' for an unrestricted second unit
fix: When the analyzer is asked about a unit together with a unit, the first is linked to the second through shared words.

what: The formula requires one document to be the other without its frontmatter (Bare). 'differ only in frontmatter' also covers two documents with different frontmatters, or both stripped to the same body, so the relation cannot be recovered.
collapse: paraphrased the Bare relation as a loose symmetric 'differ only in'
fix: When one document is another without its frontmatter, checker reports a finding for both or for neither.

what: The prose drops the condition that the document's frontmatter is a listing frontmatter (a frontmatter with a plugins key). It only says the frontmatter lists the plugin, and nothing ties lists to Listing.
collapse: took 'lists the plugin' to imply 'has a plugins key'
fix: It must be possible for a run to call an installed plugin that checker runs over a document whose frontmatter has a plugins key and lists that plugin, get code 1 back from it, and itself exit with code 1.

what: The formula needs a search in Trial (a primitive 'leaves one unit out') that leaves out the unit. 'leaves out only this unit' says no other unit is left out, which is not Trial.
collapse: paraphrased the Trial term plus Leave as 'only this unit'
fix: …then some search that leaves one unit out and leaves out this unit requires the scenario to happen.

what: In the last rule, 'repeats another' requires the repeated unit to differ from the repeating one. The formula also covers a unit that repeats itself.
collapse: said 'another' for an unrestricted second unit
fix: - when a unit repeats a unit, checker reports a finding for the repeating unit

what: The prose states every condition ('holds a formula that is lone on a signature' covers both Logical and loneOn). Sonnet dropped the condition that the unit holds a formula.
collapse: merged 'holds a formula' and 'that formula is lone' into one relative clause
fix: None needed. To be safer: 'When a unit that is not a term holds a formula, and that formula is lone on a signature, checker reports it as lone on that signature.'

what: Sonnet reversed the context relation and wrote d2->d1 where the prose's 'the other is context for it' is d1->d2. Separately, the prose's 'another' would exclude a document that extends itself, which the formula covers.
collapse: said 'another' for an unrestricted second document
fix: When a document extends a document, the latter is context for the former, and so is every document that is context for the latter.

what: The prose says the unlisted document is context for a listed one (listed->unlisted in Context). Sonnet and Haiku wrote it the other way round (unlisted->listed).
collapse: none on the prose side
fix: None needed.

what: 'a formula … held by a non-term unit' states that the unit holds a formula (Logical). Sonnet dropped that condition, and Haiku also widened Signature to Word.
collapse: named the formula as the subject so that 'holds a formula' becomes implicit
fix: None needed. To be safer: 'When a unit that is not a term holds a formula that is lone on a signature, checker reports it as lone on the signature.'
